text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty P-45218 triggered for `redwood-api` - alert: 5xx spike across generation endpoints. Severity: P0. Link: https://pagerduty.example/p/incidents/P-45218

eng-oncall-james: acking on behalf of primary oncall. I'm booting up a quick dashboard and checking retries.

pd-bot: ACK recorded: eng-oncall-james (mobile). Note: mobile DND is ON on device for eng-oncall-james.

incident-bot: Notification: no response to page within 90s; escalation policy fired -> paging secondary: sre-amy.

sre-amy: seeing the spike on the latency/error dashboard. 40% of generate requests returning 500 over last 2m, median RT increased to 1.8s from 300ms. Starting triage.

sre-amy: @support-lee can you confirm any open customer tickets? Which customers are impacted?

support-lee: getting a few inbound support chats from enterprise customers in EU and one paid customer in NA. All cite "generation failure" or blank responses. Forwarded logs from their session ids.

sre-amy: thanks. immediate plan: 1) disable model-fanout to experimental replicas 2) route traffic to stable model variant (redwood-gpt-stable-v2) 3) scale dedicated inference pool + restart unhealthy pods.

eng-oncall-james: on my side I can run a rollout restart, but I'm remote with flaky VPN. If I drop, please escalate to manager.

ops-michael: I can take the kubectl steps. Running:
```kubectl -n inference rollout restart deployment/inference-runtime
kubectl -n inference scale deployment inference-gpu-pool --replicas=8
kubectl -n inference apply -f /manifests/routing-stable-model.yaml
```
I'll tail logs after the restart.

pd-bot: Escalation to manager-karen: manager page sent (manager escalation policy) due to P0 + missed ack window.

manager-karen: up, saw the manager page. Joining. Do we have an ETA for mitigation? Need an initial customer impact statement for exec comms.

sre-amy: initial impact: ~36-42% error rate for generate endpoints globally, concentrated in EU region and one NA cluster. Estimated affected 18 customers with heavy throughput; paying customers seeing degraded quality. We are routing to stable model now. Ops is restarting pods.

support-lee: logging sample from customer session: `2026-03-14T10:02:12Z ERROR generation failed: kv-cache OOM at step 6` repeated.

ops-michael: after restart, pods came back but a subset show repeated OOMs on quantized kernels. Increasing memory and disabling that kernel as a mitigation.

eng-oncall-james: re-routing policy applied. We will fallback to CPU-safe path for small requests while GPU pool stabilizes.

incident-bot: Incident P-45218 status update: mitigations applied (routing fallback, pool scaled, restarts). Monitoring for recovery.

sre-amy: observed error rate dropping to ~8% after routing and restarts. Latency trending back to 500-700ms. Continuing to monitor for 15m.

manager-karen: preparing a customer-facing note. Key points: root cause under investigation but immediate mitigation applied, partial recovery, support to proactively reach out to top affected customers.

support-lee: I'll draft outreach and share internal copy.

eng-oncall-james: thanks team. If error rate holds <10% for next 20m, we can start rollback of temporary routing. I'll remain on-call for handoff in 30m.

ops-michael: adding a checkpoint: I'll capture a heap/profile and upload to S3 for the model infra team. Command run: `kubectl exec -it pod/inference-runtime-xyz -- /usr/local/bin/dump-kv-cache --out /tmp/kvdump.tar` then `aws s3 cp /tmp/kvdump.tar s3://redwood-debug/P-45218/`.

sre-amy: noted. Post-incident actions: 1) add safer kernel fallback for quantized path 2) increase OOM alerts thresholds and add early warning on kv-cache growth 3) run canary with longer tail latencies before deploys.

manager-karen: approved. Please include cost impact estimate in postmortem. Also include whether Dedicated customers were affected and any SLA hits.

incident-bot: PD Incident P-45218: current state = monitoring. Next update scheduled in 15m or on status change.

eng-oncall-james: quick handoff: I'll be available for 30m. If anyone needs to take over, ping `@sre-amy` and `@ops-michael`.

support-lee: outreach draft ready, posting to #customer-comms for review.

sre-amy: error rates stable at ~4% now. I'm going to capture relevant logs and move to postmortem prep.

manager-karen: thanks. Once we have confirmed stable for 30m, convert to P1 and close PD incident.

pd-bot: Note: eng-oncall-james acknowledged at 2219001250. SRE secondary ack at 2219001260. Manager escalation acknowledged at 2219001275.

eng-oncall-james: :thumbsup: closing loop, great work everyone.

incident-bot: PD Incident P-45218 -> monitoring -> awaiting final confirmation for closure.
